read.thesis: RTX raised FY26 sales to $95-96B and EPS to $7.10-7.25 on a record $289B backlog, with Raytheon output more than doubled and GTF AOGs down 25% YTD.

capex.quote: Raytheon is investing an additional $100 million domestically to increase GEM-T component production and accelerate LTAMDS's test capabilities

triggers.label: FY sales guide raised $2.5B
triggers.quote: we're raising our full year adjusted sales outlook by $2.5 billion to a new range of $95 billion to $96 billion

triggers.label: Raytheon output more than doubled
triggers.quote: we've more than doubled year-over-year output across our critical munitions through the first half of the year

triggers.label: Raytheon book-to-bill 2.42
triggers.quote: Bookings in the quarter were $19.9 billion resulting in a book-to-bill of 2.42

triggers.label: Working capital headwind from inventory build
triggers.quote: we're going to be building a little bit of inventory to make sure that we're prepared to deliver the continued ramp

guidance.quote: we're raising our full year adjusted sales outlook by $2.5 billion to a new range of $95 billion to $96 billion
We now see adjusted EPS of between $7.10 and $7.25 for the full year
we now expect free cash flow to be between $8.5 billion and $8.75 billion for the full year
in the second half, you'll see in our outlook, it implies somewhere in the 5% range at the midpoint of our outlook
we now think our OE sales for Pratt will be down in the low single-digit range

red_flags.label: Inventory build ahead of ramp; working capital headwind
Pratt OE sales down on material allocation to MRO
red_flags.quote: we continue to ensure that we have strong material flow into our MRO shops

evasions.topic: Free cash flow top-end not raised
evasions.quote: there was some timing. There always is with the free cash flow in the quarter
